notes: Residential population: INSEE Filosofi 2021, 200m national grid (real census data, already fine-grained, no placement needed). Jobs: INSEE SIRENE establishment-level registry (real address per establishment, headcount reported as a size bracket rather than an exact count), snapped to the nearest real OpenStreetMap building footprint -- replaces the older population-weighted job estimate used on earlier France maps. Commuting flows: INSEE RP2022 individual mobility microdata, aggregated to a full commune-to-commune matrix, minimum 10km origin-destination distance enforced. Routes calculated via OSRM on the real road network.
